name: Network Sniffing
summary: Network sniffing is the practice of using a network interface on a computer system to monitor or capture information regardless of whether it is the specified destination for the information. An adversary may attempt to sniff the traffic to gain information about the target. This information can vary in the level of importance. Relatively unimportant information is general communications to and from machines. Relatively important information…

analytics.name: Analytic 1932
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process loading a packet capture driver or executing a known capture utility on an Industrial Control System (ICS) host's network interface, from a process or account not associated with documented network analysis responsibilities. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2156
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process opening a raw socket or executing tcpdump/tshark on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset's network interface, from a User Identifier (UID) that does not normally perform packet capture. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2201
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a new device on the Industrial Control System (ICS) network placing its Network Interface Card (NIC) in promiscuous mode, detectable by anomalous broadcast traffic handling or unauthorized Switched Port Analyzer (SPAN) session requests on managed switches. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2202
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies unauthorized Switch Port Analyzer (SPAN) session configuration or port mirroring enabled from a source not in the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) on an Industrial Control System (ICS) switch. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
